description: Defines a PvE mission stage: map fallback, wave/binding-vow lotteries, and the named calculation rows used for risk, money and experience payouts.

Id.technical: FName import key/row name for FGameDataTableRow_PvEMission. Mission ids are produced by GamePvE_PickMission (survival sequence or weighted lottery) and resolved through PvEMissionDataTables (DTM+0x900). The member is also read as data at result time: the id is appended to PvESettings.PlayedMissionIds and written into the online result KPI row.

Id_Map.technical: FName, default None. GamePvE_GetMissionMapId takes the row's Id_Map and, when it is None or the mission row is missing, substitutes Story_PickRandomMapId_12FD510. Exported survival rows use None, so they rely on the random fallback; other rows use ids such as MAP_01.

Id_PvEMissionWaveLottery.simple: Wave lottery rows available to this mission.
Id_PvEMissionWaveLottery.technical: TArray<FName>, default empty. GamePvE_PickMissionWaves resolves each id against PvEMissionWaveLotteryDataTables (DTM+0x920), collects the rows and builds rank-qualified wave candidates. Survival missions reference a survival wave lottery; other missions may list several pools.

Id_PvECalculation_RiskValue.simple: Named risk multiplier for this mission.
Id_PvECalculation_RiskValue.technical: FName, default None. GamePvE_CalcResultRiskValue multiplies the accumulated risk by this row's Value when the lookup succeeds; the final risk is floored to int32 and forced to 0 below max risk or on a loss.

Id_PvECalculation_Money.simple: Named money multiplier for this mission.
Id_PvECalculation_Money.technical: FName, default None. GamePvE_CalcResultMoney multiplies max(battle bonus sum, 0) by this calculation row's Value. It is also mapped through GMoneyMissionDifficultyMap to build the difficulty sum used by whole-run mode-clear money bonuses.

Id_PvECalculation_Experience.simple: Named experience multiplier for this mission.
Id_PvECalculation_Experience.technical: FName, default None. GamePvE_CalcResultExperience multiplies the evaluation-row value by this calculation row's Value (when present), then applies task/vow/help factors. It is also mapped through GExperienceMissionDifficultyMap for mode-clear experience bonuses.

Id_BindingVowsLottery.simple: Binding-vow lottery pools offered for this mission.
Id_BindingVowsLottery.technical: TArray<FName>, default empty. PvE interval setup iterates this array in parallel with Weights, skips None entries, resolves each id in BindingVowsLotteryDataTables and then applies additional order/task exclusions before weighted vow picking.

Weights.simple: Weights for choosing among the binding-vow lotteries.
Weights.technical: TArray<float>, default empty. Each same-index value is paired with a non-None Id_BindingVowsLottery entry, and GameSound_PickWeightedIndex selects one pool. Exported rows use 1.0 for enabled slots; no repeat penalty is applied at this stage, unlike mission/wave picking.

notes: The exported asset has 1073 rows with FGameDataTableRow_PvEMission; the manager loads PvEMissionDataTable into PvEMissionDataTables (DTM+0x900). No localization variants or numbered shards were supplied for this table.

This row is a hub joining PvEMissionWaveLottery, PvECalculation and BindingVowsLottery. The active row is also cached in FStudioBattleMissionTaskSystem and read by online KPI and result-state code via AGameBattleManager::GetPvEMission.

The Id_BindingVowsLottery/Weights arrays and Id_PvEMissionWaveLottery arrays are parallel to their targets; exported rows pad with None/zero. Consumers generally check the id but not the array length of the companion weight array.
Finders 0x12fb320 and 0x1625810 are reconstructed (behavioural in status/functions.json); this is not a byte-parity claim. Content is partial and Blueprint uses were not exhaustively inspected.

usages.detail: GamePvE_FindMissionRow resolves mission ids against PvEMissionDataTables.
GamePvE_GetMissionMapId reads Id_Map and falls back to a random map.
GamePvE_PickMissionWaves resolves the mission's wave lotteries.
Binds Id_BindingVowsLottery and Weights into the pre-battle vow lottery.
Result calculations consume the three Id_PvECalculation_* fields.
Battle setup resolves the mission row and passes it, its waves and tasks to SetupPvEMission.
